entry.name: trayLayout
entry.label: Tray layout: auto, icon, compact or wide.

entry.name: detailLayout
entry.label: Detail header layout: auto, stacked or side.

entry.name: icon
entry.label: Tray icon name, or "auto" for the built-in headset icon.

entry.name: batteryPosition
entry.label: Battery placement: "right", "left" or "overlay" (badge on the icon).

entry.name: batteryFont
entry.label: Font family for the tray battery text; empty = system default.

entry.name: batteryFontSize
entry.label: Font size (px) for the tray battery text; 0 = automatic.
